AccessControl.title: AccessControl
AccessControl.description: Global application availability, copyright signature, and offline-verifiable hashed passcode policy controlled exclusively by the verified owner.

isActive.description: Whether the shared application is currently active for non-owner users.

pauseMessage.description: Arabic message displayed to shared-link users when the application is paused.

ownerSignature.description: Intellectual property and copyright attribution displayed across the app, lock screen, and Excel exports.

passcodeEnabled.description: Whether users must enter a valid passcode on every app open (works both online and offline).

passcodeSalt.description: Random hex salt for PBKDF2-SHA256 verification of the global master passcode (empty if unset).

passcodeHash.description: PBKDF2-SHA256 hex digest of the global master passcode (never plaintext).

passcodeVersion.description: Monotonically increasing session version incremented to immediately lock and revoke all active sessions.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified owner who last updated the policy.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status or security change.

OwnerAccessKey.title: OwnerAccessKey
OwnerAccessKey.description: Owner-private registry of named personal access keys (strictly isolated from public reads so labels/names never leak).

label.description: Human-readable name or site tag of the authorized user (visible to owner only).

active.description: Whether this individual user access key is currently active.

expiresAt.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD expiration date (empty string for no expiry).

version.description: Access policy version at key issuance.

createdBy.description: Immutable UID of the owner who created this key.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of key creation.

AccessPass.title: AccessPass
AccessPass.description: Zero-PII blind-lookup verification record for an individual access code (single-doc get only; collection listing is strictly forbidden).

active.description: Whether this pass is currently active.

verifySalt.description: Random hex salt for PBKDF2-SHA256 verification.

verifyHash.description: PBKDF2-SHA256 hex digest of the personal access code.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified owner who last updated this pass.

/app_config/{docId}.description: Single-document global access control, copyright attribution, and hashed master passcode (/app_config/access_control). Public get for real-time & offline cache sync; strictly owner-only create/update.

/owner_access_keys/{keyId}.description: Owner-only private registry of named per-user access keys. Completely isolated from public reads.

/access_passes/{passLookupId}.description: Blind-lookup salted verification record keyed by SHA-256(code). Single-doc get only (list strictly forbidden); owner-only write/delete.
